hotel_name: Fairmont La Hacienda Costa Del Sol

claims.text: The resort sits on the Mediterranean coast of southern Spain between Sotogrande and La Línea, in a part of the coast that is less known and less developed than nearby resort areas.

findings.quote: This part of Spain’s Mediterranean coast, between Sotogrande and La Línea, is less known and less developed than some of the more popular resort areas nearby.

claims.text: The golf courses have views of the Rock of Gibraltar, the Costa del Sol and, in the distance, Morocco.

findings.quote: The courses even have views of the Rock of Gibraltar, the Costa del Sol and, in the distance, Morocco.

claims.text: The resort's architecture is by dAAr studio, with terraces and steps built on a hillside between the main building and the freestanding villas.

findings.quote: The resort’s striking architecture is the work of dAAr studio
a brilliant set of steps and terraces built on a hillside between the main building and the freestanding villas

claims.text: The interiors are by Studio Ibu and use natural materials such as Campaspero limestone, noble woods, and jute and linen textiles.

findings.quote: Studio Ibu was responsible for the interiors
natural materials such as Campaspero limestone, noble woods, textiles such as jute and linen

claims.text: All rooms have terraces with views of the sea, the golf courses, or the large swimming pool.

findings.quote: all have terraces with views of the sea, the golf courses, or the large swimming pool

claims.text: El Faro de la Hacienda serves breakfast, lunch and dinner.

findings.quote: El Faro de la Hacienda, open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner

claims.text: The spa area includes hammams, a sauna, hydrotherapy, a snow fountain and a yoga studio.

findings.quote: two hammams, a sauna, swimming pools, hydrotherapy, a snow fountain, a yoga studio

claims.text: Spa treatments use products from Subtle Energies and 111Skincare.

findings.quote: products from Australia’s Subtle Energies and the London-based 111Skincare

claims.text: Gibraltar International Airport is about a 25-minute drive from the resort.

findings.quote: **Gibraltar International Airport (GIB): ~25-minute drive.**

claims.text: The resort has a network of paths for buggies, available to guests 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: a network of paths for buggies, which are available to guests 24 hours a day

claims.text: The resort has direct access to La Alcaidesa beach, a sandy beach with the Punta Carbonera lighthouse.

findings.quote: direct access to La Alcaidesa beach, a sandy strip that runs for four kilometres and is presided over by the Punta Carbonera lighthouse

claims.text: Guests can book tee times on the Links and Heathland golf courses, designed by Peter Alliss, Clive Clark and Kurtis Bowman.

findings.quote: reserve tee times on the Links and Heathland courses designed by Peter Alliss, Clive Clark, and Kurtis Bowman

claims.text: Chef Benito Gómez, behind Bardal in Ronda, is in charge of the restaurant Dalmar, which serves food for sharing in a relaxed atmosphere.

findings.quote: Benito Gómez, one of Spain’s best chefs and the man behind the highly acclaimed Bardal (in Ronda)
he is in charge of the Dalmar restaurant, where his goal is to serve delicious food in a relaxed atmosphere, with many options for sharing

claims.text: Guests can book yacht trips from the port of Sotogrande and sail among dolphins.

findings.quote: guests can book yacht trips from the port of Sotogrande and sail among dolphins

claims.text: A sculpture of a whale's tail stands in the middle of the lobby.

findings.quote: In the middle of the space, a sculpture of a whale’s tail sets the mood.

claims.text: Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport is about a 1 hour 20-minute drive from the resort.

findings.quote: **Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport (AGP): ~1 hour 20-minute drive.**

claims.text: Airport and station transfers need to be booked 48 hours prior to arrival.

findings.quote: Transfers need to be booked 48 hours prior to arrival.

claims.text: Parking at the resort is available for an additional fee.

findings.quote: Parking available for an additional fee
